parts.when: [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

**Target:** A **TERMINATOR** unit of yours that is a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed** before it has fought in the phase, roll a D6. On a 4+, leave the model on the battlefield; it can still fight once the enemy unit finishes attacking, and is then removed. This lasts for the rest of the phase.

effects.condition: model has not fought this phase
effects.then: not removed; fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then removed from play
